item.title: GKIDS Brings Shoji Kawamori's LABYRINTH Anime Film To North American Theaters In May
item.description: GKIDS has acquired North American rights to the original anime film Labyrinth, screening it in theaters during May this year, the film will have English subtitles and an English dub available for watchers.

item.title: DOROHEDORO Season 2 Global Premiere Date, Updated Staff And Key Visual Revealed
item.description: The official Dorohedoro anime site has dropped a fresh key visual for Season 2 along with updated staff credits and a confirmed global premiere date for this spring.

item.title: ICHIJOMA MANKITSU GURASHI! Anime Unveils Four New Characters And A Fresh Teaser Trailer
item.description: The TV anime adaptation of Kumako Hisama's Ichijōma Mankitsu Gurashi! has revealed four additional characters and a new teaser trailer, building anticipation for its April 2026 debut.

item.title: TOKYO GHOUL Creator Sui Ishida Gives A Very Humble Response To Anime Criticism On Social Media
item.description: A viral X post revives Sui Ishida's old 2021 livestream comments about the Tokyo Ghoul anime adaptation, where he expressed gratitude despite fan frustrations over manga deviations

item.title: ONE PIECE Season 2 Trailer Arrives Tomorrow, Get Ready for "The Greatest Pirate Era"
item.description: A new trailer for Netflix's One Piece Season 2 is set arrive tomorrow, ushering in the "greatest pirate era." Ahead of its release, a new poster warns of Baroque Works.

item.title: COSMIC PRINCESS KAGUYA! Anime Film Announces One Week Theatrical Run Next Month
item.description: Shingo Yamashita's original anime film Cosmic Princess Kaguya! will screen in Japanese theaters for one week in February this year following its original premiere on Netflix in January.

item.title: ONE PIECE Season 2 Trailer Sets Sail With Tony Tony Chopper And More Big Reveals
item.description: Netflix has released the trailer for One Piece Season 2, featuring some exciting first looks at several iconic characters and locations fans have been eagerly awaiting seeing on screen.

item.title: CHAINSAW MAN: REZE ARC Anime Film Will Be On Crunchyroll This Spring
item.description: Crunchyroll will stream Chainsaw Man – The Movie: Reze Arc this spring in both Japanese with English subtitles and English dub, following its successful theatrical run and digital release.

item.title: THE CLASSROOM OF A BLACK CAT AND A WITCH Anime Reveals Ending Theme Ahead Of April Premiere
item.description: Spira Spica will perform the ending theme "Tune Up" for The Classroom of a Black Cat and a Witch anime, joining ASCA's opening track "Cusp" as the series prepares for its April 2026 debut.

item.title: Crunchyroll Manga Adds 30 New Titles From J-Novel Club To Its App Library
item.description: Crunchyroll has expanded its manga app with 30 new light novel adaptations and manga series licensed from J-Novel Club, the new reads are filled with many genres for fans of all types.
